steps: js:(async()=>{const H={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const it=await fetch('/api/items',{headers:H}).then((r)=>r.json());const id=(c)=>it.find((x)=>x.code===c).id;const b=await fetch('/api/boms',{method:'POST',headers:H,body:JSON.stringify({productId:id('ITM-0003'),versionName:'2',defaultVersion:false,produceQty:10,lines:[{componentId:id('ITM-0005'),quantity:20},{componentId:id('ITM-0006'),quantity:10,remark:'QA재고1'}]})}).then((r)=>r.json());sessionStorage.setItem('qaBomId',String(b.id));return true})()

finally: js:(async()=>{const H={headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')}};const b=await fetch('/api/boms?versions=all',H).then((r)=>r.json());for(const x of b.filter((x)=>x.productCode==='ITM-0003'&&!x.defaultVersion))await fetch('/api/boms/'+x.id,{method:'DELETE',...H});return true})()
